notes.title: Demo Version 1.2
notes.notes: [p]It was brought to our attention yesterday that using Ctrl+Shift, and pressing W then jumping would cause you to propel forwards. After a few attempts, you could fly, and fling yourself off the map. After some coding changes in Crouching, you are unable to do this anymore. The movement now only reads the latest input, so Ctrl, then Shift would make you run. notes.title: JGWS - Steam Next Fest Announcement
notes.notes:
[b]JoshGeoff Weiner Simulator Demo Arrives for Steam Next Fest – June 9–16! [/b]

Hey everyone!

We’re beyond excited to announce that the Demo for JoshGeoff Weiner Simulator will be available as part of Steam Next Fest, running from June 9 to June 16! This is your first chance to step into the beautifully bizarre world of JoshGeoff Weiner Simulator, set in the grungy sites of the UK. 


[b]What to Expect in the Demo:[/b]
- The first map of Weiner Town, a grungy portside subarb of the main city.
- All collectibles of Weiner Town as it will be on Early Access Release.


[b]When & Where:[/b]
- Demo goes live on June 9, 2025 at 6PM BST.
- Available through Steam Next Fest.
- Playable through June 16th - do NOT miss out on the next achievement-based game.


[b]Help Us Improve JGWS[/b]
As JGWS is developed solely by one guy... me. It would be much appreciated if you join our [url=https://discord.jgws.xyz]Discord Server[/url] and build up our community, report bugs and give your feedback/suggestions in the correct channels. 


[b]Stream Schedules??[/b]
During Steam Next Fest, we'll continue dropping short-form content across our socials, and even have our content creators AND ourselves stream during the Demo! This gives you the opportunity to gather secrets, answer questions and see behind the scenes.

We’re excited to share that JoshGeoff Weiner Simulator has reached over 20 wishlists on Steam in the first day! 

A massive THANK YOU to everyone who has shown their support so far. Every wishlist is a huge step forward for us, and we couldn’t be more grateful!

If you haven’t added JoshGeoff Weiner Simulator to your wishlist yet, now is the perfect time to do so! We're shaping up for our first official release on Steam and we want YOU to be part of the journey. By wishlisting, you’ll be among the first to hear about updates, release dates, and exclusive offers as we get closer to launch.
